# Target-room age distribution

Existing sample: 2,956 launches across 1.72 h (1h 43m 23s), slots 463,738,720–463,767,697.

| copy cohort | n | age < 15 min | age < 30 min | age < 1 h |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| All certain copies | 1674 | 1095/1674 (65.4%) | 1328/1674 (79.3%) | 1544/1674 (92.2%) |
| Different-creator certain copies | 1201 | 789/1201 (65.7%) | 954/1201 (79.4%) | 1100/1201 (91.6%) |
| SOL liveness calibration subset | 94 | 65/94 (69.1%) | 74/94 (78.7%) | 86/94 (91.5%) |

The gate uses strict <. In the full cohort, 1 copy is exactly 30 min old; inclusive <= coverage would be 1329/1674 (79.4%).

| copy cohort | p50 | p75 | p90 | p99 |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| All certain copies | 5m 15.5s | 25m 58s | 53m 8s | 1h 29m 11s |
| Different-creator certain copies | 3m 7s | 26m 12s | 56m 10s | 1h 30m 51s |
| SOL liveness calibration subset | 3m 7.5s | 26m 23s | 51m 59s | 1h 32m 40s |

| copy cohort | selected grace coverage | loss versus previous 2 h (percentage points) |
|---|---|---|
| All certain copies | 1544/1674 (92.2%) | 7.77 |
| Different-creator certain copies | 1100/1201 (91.6%) | 8.41 |
| SOL liveness calibration subset | 86/94 (91.5%) | 8.51 |

Choose T_new = 1 h. It lies inside the observed window and covers more than nine in ten copies in each cohort; the shorter half-hour option covers about four in five. This trades some observed grace coverage for a shorter poisoning window, rather than choosing a grace longer than the entire sample to retain every observed copy.

All-certain-copy and different-creator ages use the earliest earlier identity/URI-matching launch, regardless of quote currency. The SOL subset uses the earlier recorded SOL-quoted members, matching the original gate calibration. Copy identity and ordering are exactly the text calibration rules. p50 is the sample median; other quantiles use sorted[min(n-1, floor(p*n))]. The runtime age clause is strict (<); boundary counts are recorded in the JSON.

Grace coverage is not full routing recall: older funded/active rooms can pass the mature branch. The SOL reserve/idle data bound that branch in liveness_table.md. Full-cohort mature-room histories and historical trailing volume are unavailable. Room creation is an earliest-observed-member proxy; pre-window ancestors are unobserved, so this short sample cannot establish long-run recall.
